{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "2173e1ab-fd0e-53d9-84cc-76ed56aa32a5" :question/worked-solution "First, we find the natural logarithm $(\ln)$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}e^{3t+9}&=15 \\ \ln(e^{3t+9})&=\ln(15)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we use the fact that $\ln(e^u)=u$ to simplify the left-hand side. This gives

$$
3t+9=\ln(15).
$$

Finally, we solve for $t,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}3t+9&=\ln(15) \\ 3t&=\ln(15)-9 \\ t&=\frac{1}{3}\left(\ln(15)-9\right) \\ t&=-3+\frac{1}{3}\ln(15)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $t=-3+\frac{1}{3}\ln(15).$"] [:db/add "2173e1ab-fd0e-53d9-84cc-76ed56aa32a5" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "2173e1ab-fd0e-53d9-84cc-76ed56aa32a5" :question/answer-fields "2d88a33d-d45c-582d-8283-57add652b29b"] [:db/ensure "2173e1ab-fd0e-53d9-84cc-76ed56aa32a5" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186087689 :knowledge-point/questions "2173e1ab-fd0e-53d9-84cc-76ed56aa32a5"] [:db/add "8e9398dd-c94b-56d8-9bc6-4772b399fb19" :answer/id #uuid "8e9398dd-c94b-56d8-9bc6-4772b399fb19"] [:db/add "8e9398dd-c94b-56d8-9bc6-4772b399fb19" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "8e9398dd-c94b-56d8-9bc6-4772b399fb19" :answer/value "\frac{\ln(25)-4}{4}"] [:db/ensure "8e9398dd-c94b-56d8-9bc6-4772b399fb19" :answer/validate] [:db/add "38cacea6-d6f6-563e-be53-65ff3b067af4" :answer-field/id #uuid "38cacea6-d6f6-563e-be53-65ff3b067af4"] [:db/add "38cacea6-d6f6-563e-be53-65ff3b067af4" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "38cacea6-d6f6-563e-be53-65ff3b067af4" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "38cacea6-d6f6-563e-be53-65ff3b067af4" :answer-field/choices "8e9398dd-c94b-56d8-9bc6-4772b399fb19"] [:db/add "38cacea6-d6f6-563e-be53-65ff3b067af4" :answer-field/correct "8e9398dd-c94b-56d8-9bc6-4772b399fb19"] [:db/ensure "38cacea6-d6f6-563e-be53-65ff3b067af4" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "0d5857fb-0238-5a41-804e-93aaf70c5113" :question/id #uuid "0d5857fb-0238-5a41-804e-93aaf70c5113"] [:db/add "0d5857fb-0238-5a41-804e-93aaf70c5113" :question/problem "Find the **exact** solution of the equation $e^{4+4y}=25.$

{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "0d5857fb-0238-5a41-804e-93aaf70c5113" :question/worked-solution "First, we find the natural logarithm $(\ln)$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}e^{4+4y}&=25 \\ \ln(e^{4+4y})&=\ln(25)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we use the fact that $\ln(e^u)=u$ to simplify the left-hand side. This gives

$$
4+4y=\ln(25).
$$

Finally, we solve for $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4+4y&=\ln(25) \\ 4y&=\ln(25)-4 \\ y&=\frac{1}{4}\left(\ln(25)-4\right) \\ y&=-1+\frac{1}{4}\ln(25)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $y=-1+\frac{1}{4}\ln(25).$"] [:db/add "0d5857fb-0238-5a41-804e-93aaf70c5113" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "0d5857fb-0238-5a41-804e-93aaf70c5113" :question/answer-fields "38cacea6-d6f6-563e-be53-65ff3b067af4"] [:db/ensure "0d5857fb-0238-5a41-804e-93aaf70c5113" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186087689 :knowledge-point/questions "0d5857fb-0238-5a41-804e-93aaf70c5113"] [:db/add "69814916-fde3-5a92-a267-34531a131146" :answer/id #uuid "69814916-fde3-5a92-a267-34531a131146"] [:db/add "69814916-fde3-5a92-a267-34531a131146" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "69814916-fde3-5a92-a267-34531a131146" :answer/value "\frac{\ln(11)+9}{5}"] [:db/ensure "69814916-fde3-5a92-a267-34531a131146" :answer/validate] [:db/add "2113adec-9496-52e2-9fa0-ad2cda8f3357" :answer-field/id #uuid "2113adec-9496-52e2-9fa0-ad2cda8f3357"] [:db/add "2113adec-9496-52e2-9fa0-ad2cda8f3357" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "2113adec-9496-52e2-9fa0-ad2cda8f3357" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "2113adec-9496-52e2-9fa0-ad2cda8f3357" :answer-field/choices "69814916-fde3-5a92-a267-34531a131146"] [:db/add "2113adec-9496-52e2-9fa0-ad2cda8f3357" :answer-field/correct "69814916-fde3-5a92-a267-34531a131146"] [:db/ensure "2113adec-9496-52e2-9fa0-ad2cda8f3357" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "f9755790-72b4-5435-8b21-7c99371dbf69" :question/id #uuid "f9755790-72b4-5435-8b21-7c99371dbf69"] [:db/add "f9755790-72b4-5435-8b21-7c99371dbf69" :question/problem "Find the **exact** solution of the equation $e^{5y-9}=11.$

{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "f9755790-72b4-5435-8b21-7c99371dbf69" :question/worked-solution "First, we find the natural logarithm $(\ln)$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}e^{5y-9}&=11 \\ \ln(e^{5y-9})&=\ln(11)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we use the fact that $\ln(e^u)=u$ to simplify the left-hand side. This gives

$$
5y-9=\ln(11).
$$

Finally, we solve for $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}5y-9&=\ln(11) \\ 5y&=\ln(11)+9 \\ y&=\frac{1}{5}\left(\ln(11)+9\right) \\ y&=\frac{9}{5}+\frac{1}{5}\ln(11)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $y=\frac{9}{5}+\frac{1}{5}\ln(11).$"] [:db/add "f9755790-72b4-5435-8b21-7c99371dbf69" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "f9755790-72b4-5435-8b21-7c99371dbf69" :question/answer-fields "2113adec-9496-52e2-9fa0-ad2cda8f3357"] [:db/ensure "f9755790-72b4-5435-8b21-7c99371dbf69" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186087689 :knowledge-point/questions "f9755790-72b4-5435-8b21-7c99371dbf69"] [:db/add "49c9950d-5415-5b47-8499-e4c25278d5ad" :answer/id #uuid "49c9950d-5415-5b47-8499-e4c25278d5ad"] [:db/add "49c9950d-5415-5b47-8499-e4c25278d5ad" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "49c9950d-5415-5b47-8499-e4c25278d5ad" :answer/value "\frac{\ln(10)-3}{2}"] [:db/ensure "49c9950d-5415-5b47-8499-e4c25278d5ad" :answer/validate] [:db/add "4585e6cc-0f8b-59e0-8f70-300fdb24aab2" :answer-field/id #uuid "4585e6cc-0f8b-59e0-8f70-300fdb24aab2"] [:db/add "4585e6cc-0f8b-59e0-8f70-300fdb24aab2" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "4585e6cc-0f8b-59e0-8f70-300fdb24aab2" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "4585e6cc-0f8b-59e0-8f70-300fdb24aab2" :answer-field/choices "49c9950d-5415-5b47-8499-e4c25278d5ad"] [:db/add "4585e6cc-0f8b-59e0-8f70-300fdb24aab2" :answer-field/correct "49c9950d-5415-5b47-8499-e4c25278d5ad"] [:db/ensure "4585e6cc-0f8b-59e0-8f70-300fdb24aab2" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "116eef0d-fc21-56c3-88da-a38fa1536d37" :question/id #uuid "116eef0d-fc21-56c3-88da-a38fa1536d37"] [:db/add "116eef0d-fc21-56c3-88da-a38fa1536d37" :question/problem "Find the **exact** solution of the equation $e^{3+2y}=10.$

{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "116eef0d-fc21-56c3-88da-a38fa1536d37" :question/worked-solution "First, we find the natural logarithm $(\ln)$ of both sides of the equation:

{{field-1}}"] ["f9755790-72b4-5435-8b21-7c99371dbf69" :question/worked-solution "First, we find the natural logarithm $(\ln)$ of both sides of the equation:

$$

$$
5y-9=\ln(11).
$$

$$

knowledge_point.title: Finding Exact Solutions to Exponential Equations Using the Natural Logarithm

question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we find the natural logarithm $(\ln)$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}e^{3t+9}&=15 \\ \ln(e^{3t+9})&=\ln(15)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we use the fact that $\ln(e^u)=u$ to simplify the left-hand side. This gives

$$
3t+9=\ln(15).
$$

Finally, we solve for $t,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}3t+9&=\ln(15) \\ 3t&=\ln(15)-9 \\ t&=\frac{1}{3}\left(\ln(15)-9\right) \\ t&=-3+\frac{1}{3}\ln(15)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $t=-3+\frac{1}{3}\ln(15).$

question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we find the natural logarithm $(\ln)$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}e^{4+4y}&=25 \\ \ln(e^{4+4y})&=\ln(25)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we use the fact that $\ln(e^u)=u$ to simplify the left-hand side. This gives

$$
4+4y=\ln(25).
$$

Finally, we solve for $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4+4y&=\ln(25) \\ 4y&=\ln(25)-4 \\ y&=\frac{1}{4}\left(\ln(25)-4\right) \\ y&=-1+\frac{1}{4}\ln(25)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $y=-1+\frac{1}{4}\ln(25).$

\begin{aligned}e^{5y-9}&=11 \\ \ln(e^{5y-9})&=\ln(11)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we use the fact that $\ln(e^u)=u$ to simplify the left-hand side. This gives

$$
5y-9=\ln(11).
$$

Finally, we solve for $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}5y-9&=\ln(11) \\ 5y&=\ln(11)+9 \\ y&=\frac{1}{5}\left(\ln(11)+9\right) \\ y&=\frac{9}{5}+\frac{1}{5}\ln(11)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $y=\frac{9}{5}+\frac{1}{5}\ln(11).$

knowledge_point.title: Finding Exact Solutions to Exponential Equations Using the Natural Logarithm

question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we find the natural logarithm $(\ln)$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}e^{3+2y}&=10 \\ \ln(e^{3+2y})&=\ln(10)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we use the fact that $\ln(e^u)=u$ to simplify the left-hand side. This gives

$$
3+2y=\ln(10).
$$

Finally, we solve for $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}3+2y&=\ln(10) \\ 2y&=\ln(10)-3 \\ y&=\frac{1}{2}\left(\ln(10)-3\right) \\ y&=-\frac{3}{2}+\frac{1}{2}\ln(10)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $y=-\frac{3}{2}+\frac{1}{2}\ln(10).$

question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we find the natural logarithm $(\ln)$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}e^{-3y-7}&=24 \\ \ln(e^{-3y-7})&=\ln(24)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we use the fact that $\ln(e^u)=u$ to simplify the left-hand side. This gives

$$
-3y-7=\ln(24).
$$

Finally, we solve for $y,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}-3y-7&=\ln(24) \\ -3y&=\ln(24)+7 \\ y&=\frac{1}{-3}\left(\ln(24)+7\right) \\ y&=-\frac{7}{3}-\frac{1}{3}\ln(24)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $y=-\frac{7}{3}-\frac{1}{3}\ln(24).$
